chitransh-cj-kimchi-root.description: Turn a raw product idea into build-ready docs — one doc per EPIC with locked decisions, exact API contracts, a story-by-story priority plan, and an execute.md handoff Claude can build from across sessions. Gets the clarity by interrogating the user through a roster of expert personas that grill, counter, and refuse to flatter. Use to ideate, validate, scope, architect, or plan a product, feature, startup, or app before any code is written. Invoke by persona name or acronym to summon one expert, or with no argument to run the full lifecycle end to end.
